text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer talks with Fuji Kiseki. Before 
long, she confides her worries about 
whether she is truly worthy of everyone's 
expectations.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fearing that she might one day let 
everyone down, the overwhelming craze had 
turned into immense pressure...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki has delivered "miracles" to so 
many people. Her Trainer tells her that 
she truly is a wonderful Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:

many people. Her Trainer tells her that 
she truly is a wonderful Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer showed Fuji Kiseki the 
practice session of that junior. Thanks to 
Fuji Kiseki, she has transformed and is 
looking toward the future...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having regained her confidence from the 
Trainer's words, Fuji Kiseki realized she 
wasn't alone. The two resolved to overcome 
everything together.
